reason: Mixed native and offline-shader rendering. The native layer builds a luminance/solid-angle environment alias table, uploads the immutable structured buffer and binds it to material lighting and reflection. Shared shader functions sample that exact distribution with multiple importance sampling.
host_contract: Windows x86_64 D3D12 visual client. The source cubemap, packed table and material shaders share one scene lifetime. Source M3 materials and textures retain their existing identities. The 16-byte alias ABI includes dimension and uniform-fallback metadata.
rollback: Restore the original source and shader bundle, rebuild, then verify the native identity and deterministic capture. Shader replacement is checked using one unchanged executable and a source-bound scene.
